summary: An Apple voicemail transcription feature turned a routine message from a car dealership into text that included a sexual reference and an insult. The recipient found it startling but funny. An expert pointed to background noise and the caller reading from a script.
technical_summary: Apple's automatic voice-to-text produced a garbled transcript of a scripted business voicemail recorded with background noise, inserting offensive wording. The error appears to be a speech recognition failure under noisy, scripted audio, with no filter for inappropriate output.

summary: A video showed a Tesla running Full Self-Driving Beta 11.4.1 detecting a pedestrian at a marked crosswalk but not yielding, apparently violating the law. No one was hurt, and the poster praised the behavior as human-like.
technical_summary: The FSD Beta display showed the pedestrian was detected, yet the vehicle slowed only slightly and continued through the crosswalk. The system appears to follow a human-like heuristic rather than complying with the legal requirement to yield to pedestrians.

summary: A Brazilian bricklayer reportedly travelled over 2,000 km to meet a woman he believed he had fallen for online, but she was an AI-generated figure. He ran out of money in Belo Horizonte and sought municipal help. Similar cases occurred in the city.
technical_summary: A synthetic AI persona posting videos and sending automated replies offered a relationship and life on a farm, drawing in a lonely man. The excerpts describe it as the third similar case in under six months, targeting vulnerable people with appealing synthetic videos.

summary: New Jersey Transit used a National Weather Service storm-surge simulation with wrong settings before Hurricane Sandy, underestimating flooding. It left hundreds of rail cars in a low-lying yard, and a surge caused over $120 million in damage.
technical_summary: Storm-surge modeling software was run with incorrect storm track and speed inputs, so predicted surges were about half the forecast levels. Officials relied on the output when deciding where to store trains, a misuse of a forecasting tool rather than a flaw in the tool.

notes: The agency disputes the findings; exact use of the software is unclear.

summary: Facebook pages posted AI-generated airport interview videos in which fake expatriates said they would return to Kosovo to vote for a prime minister candidate. Fact-checking tools rated them as AI-generated.
technical_summary: Synthetic interview videos set in Pristina Airport fabricated diaspora voter enthusiasm ahead of early elections. Detection tools such as Hive Moderation scored them 95 to 99.9 percent likely AI-generated, and the videos drew thousands of views.

summary: California drivers sued gas station operators and Kalibrate, alleging the AI-based pricing tool let competitors coordinate and raise pump prices by up to 30 cents per gallon where widely used. The defendants did not respond or declined comment.
technical_summary: Kalibrate Fuel Pricing ingests competitors' price data and recommends prices, allegedly steering users away from undercutting rivals and acting as a hub for tacit collusion. The proposed class action cites California antitrust law and a new algorithmic price-fixing statute.
